verdict: Bullish acceleration — MRVL +25% on Jensen's 'trillion-dollar' Computex call; DRAM Q1 +81% QoQ; AVGO earnings Jun 3
body_md:
## Watchlist movers (last 24–72h)
- **MRVL +~25% (record ~$285)** — NVIDIA's Jensen Huang called Marvell **"the next trillion-dollar company"** on the Computex / GTC Taipei stage, citing its networking/connectivity silicon as the backbone of multi-chip AI data centers. Builds on NVDA's ~$2B MRVL stake (Mar 2026). *This is the exact NVIDIA-names-partner catalyst.* (CNBC / DigiTimes)
- **NOK +~9%** — Morgan Stanley upgrade (PT €11→€14, Overweight); new AI Networking lab in Sunnyvale; ~+140% YTD to multi-decade highs.
- **MU +~5%** — analyst PT hikes (DB $1,000, Mizuho $1,150); crosses ~$1.16T cap; Q3 FY26 earnings Jun 24.
- **AMPX** — record Q1, raised FY2026 outlook; Roth PT $22 (Buy).
- **ALMU −6.5%** — no clear catalyst; pulling back from its May-13 ATH.

## Fresh developments (last 24–72h)
- **DRAM/HBM pricing (Jun 1)** — TrendForce: Q1-2026 DRAM industry revenue **+81% QoQ** (~$97B); conventional DRAM contract +93–98% QoQ (record); Q2 guided +58–63%. Memflation not abating.
- **Optical/CPO (Jun 1)** — NVIDIA unveiled **Spectrum-X Photonics** co-packaged-optics switches (409.6 Tb/s, ~5× power efficiency) for H2-2026 — pulls forward CPO adoption. Bullish COHR / LITE / CIEN.
- **Solar (Signal 6)** — **Section 232 polysilicon tariff** decision due ~**Jun 26**. Solar basket +40% YTD; FSLR/NXT benefit most if affirmed. Binary catalyst approaching.
- HBM4 capacity, hyperscaler capex, AMD MI400: no material 24–72h prints; baselines intact, no first capex guide-down.

## Context
- MRVL ~$285 ≈ ~$240B cap vs the "trillion-dollar" framing (~5× away) — aspirational, but a public CEO-stage endorsement + NVDA stake is a real structural signal for the custom-silicon + optical complex.
- **AVGO reports Jun 3 after close** — #1 custom-ASIC partner (Google/Meta); the next key read on the ASIC share-shift + AI-revenue acceleration thesis.

## Signals flashing
- DRAM memflation — accelerating — bull
- MRVL / custom-silicon + optical (NVDA endorsement) — breakout — bull
- CPO / Spectrum-X Photonics — adoption pulling forward — bull
- Solar Section-232 (~Jun 26) — binary — watch
- HBM post-2026 correction risk — latent — watch

## Most important
**MRVL +25%** on Jensen calling Marvell "the next trillion-dollar company" (Jun 2) — the exact watchlist catalyst we set up to catch. Alongside, TrendForce confirms DRAM Q1 +81% QoQ with no deceleration. AVGO earnings Jun 3 after close is the next scheduled catalyst.

*Not investment advice. Forward figures are forecasts.*
